prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer: **Kenzō Soai of Japan**—he received the **2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry** (jointly with Henri Kagan) and held Japanese citizenship at the time of the award.
